t: Heavy duty degreaser quickly removes grime, grease, soot, fuel stains, tobacco film, fly deposits, engineering oils and other tough soils from work surfaces, equipment, vehicles and tools. Ideal for use on surfaces such as stainless steel, vinyl flooring, painted surfaces, concrete and plastic. Super-concentrate formula provides up to 12 refills of the Pro Trigger Sprayer bottle, helping to reduce plastic waste.
b: Makes up to 9 Litres of Cleaning Solution
Use With SCRUBB Pro Trigger Sprayer (Sold Separately)
